messages:
Maya (partners_lead): proposal: run a 1-week SI Quickstart Accelerator for two certified SIs. Focus: marketplace listing prep, HW voucher handoff, and a joint webinar. Goal: marketplace-ready + 'verified' badge within 7 days. Thoughts?
Ethan (solutions_eng): love it. recommend sequencing: day0 infra prep, day1 lab walkthrough, day2 integration deep-dive, day3 airgap & security, day4 final cert + dry-run webinar.
Sara (partner_ops): logistics note 1: we have 3 hardware vouchers left for Q2. need to reserve ASAP. Also will need an enrollment form (name, org, cloud acct ID, contact email, desired voucher).
Kyle (marketing): webinar tie-in: 30-min product demo + 15-min SI case study + 15-min live Q&A. Can we record the demo run in the labs to use as promo clips?
Ravi (si_success): certification idea: two tiers  Verified (sandbox+MCQ) and Verified+ (on-prem test + short case study). Badges issued to partner org and named engineer. Pass criteria documented in repo.
Maya (partners_lead): good. @Ethan can you draft the sample lab script and a tiny demo app (node + Docker) we can reuse? Aim for <100 LOC server and a sample prompt flow.
Ethan (solutions_eng): yes. I'll push a starter repo: github.com/redwood-inference/si-quickstart-starter (branch: accel). Will include Dockerfile, quick deploy script `./deploy.sh`, and smoke test `curl` commands.
partners-bot: reminder  create partner enrollment form: /ops/forms by 3487665000
Sara (partner_ops): enrolment form draft done, posted: https://go.redwood/forms/si-quickstart (private). Added voucher opt-in checkbox and preferred session times (PST/UTC options).
Kyle (marketing): promo copy draft: "Get verified with Redwood: a one-week accelerator to publish your SI solution to our marketplace. Includes hands-on labs, certification, and a co-branded launch webinar." I'll make two CTA variations.
Ravi (si_success): operational checklist for Verified+:
- complete sandbox exercises (provisioning, API integration)
- pass MCQ (min 80%)
- demonstrate one on-prem airgapped deploy (video + logs)
- submit short case study (300-500 words)
Badge issuance = automated after manual review by partner success.
Maya (partners_lead): timeline constraints: voucher fulfillment takes ~3 business days. If accelerator starts next Mon, we need voucher commitments by EOD Thu. Sara, can you confirm?
Sara (partner_ops): confirmed. I'll queue fulfillment and create tracking sheet.
Ethan (solutions_eng): infra note: sandbox accounts -> ephemeral creds via `si-event-{org}` service. Token TTL 48h. Quotas: 150k tokens/day during event. We'll expose a telemetry endpoint for logs; opt-out flag available.
Kyle (marketing): assets request: need 2 screenshots, 1 short GIF (deploy flow), and partner logo assets by Tue COB for webinar page. I'll collect from partners; can we generate the GIF from the recorded demo?
Ethan (solutions_eng): yes, I'll provide a recordable CI step `ci/record-demo.yml` that produces a 15s GIF.
Ravi (si_success): scoring & retakes: MCQ (40%), practical (60%). Practical graded pass/fail with automated smoke tests + one human spot-check. One retake allowed after 48h.
Maya (partners_lead): responsibilities: Ethan -> starter repo + infra and telemetry; Sara -> vouchers & enrollment; Ravi -> cert rubric & review; Kyle -> webinar + promo. I'll handle partner comms and schedule.
partners-bot: calendar reminder created: SI Quickstart planning sync Fri 10:00 PT (link in #calendar)
Sara (partner_ops): tracking sheet: https://go.redwood/sheets/si-accelerator-tracker. Added participants from Partner Ops and Marketing.
Kyle (marketing): I'll draft the webinar registration page and share copy by Mon 09:00 PT. Also propose an embargo for the joint announcement until after the webinar.
Ethan (solutions_eng): small blocker: need two Dedicated seats for the scaling scenario. Maya, can you request from Capacity?
Maya (partners_lead): will request. Also capture risk: if vouchers used up, fallback = cloud credits only. Noted.
Ravi (si_success): suggestion: offer a "technical buddy" 1-hr session during week for each SI to help with tricky integration issues. Volunteers?
Ethan (solutions_eng): I can take 2 buddy slots.
Maya (partners_lead): great. Final call: target start date next Mon. I'll send invites + project board with deliverables. Thanks team. :sparkles:
